releaseNote.summary: A request body that breaks the flow's master schema is now refused with 400 before admission instead of faulting the instance.

migrations.title: A body that violates the master schema is refused at intake with 400
migrations.description: The body of a manual transition or start request is merged onto the latest instance data in memory and the result is validated against the flow's master schema before admission (vnext#1255). A body the write would refuse, for example a field a closed master schema (additionalProperties: false) does not allow, now answers 400 with validationErrors[].members; the instance is not set Busy, no job is queued and nothing is written. Before, the request was admitted (200 / 202) and the write failed inside the pipeline, faulting the instance. Not previewed, and so unchanged: transitions with a mapping, automatic / scheduled / event hops, requests relayed to an active SubFlow, flows without a master schema, master schemas with x-encryption paths, bodies carrying an x-storage file node. The write still validates every data version.
migrations.action: None required. A client that relied on the 200 / 202 answer for such a body must send only fields the master schema allows. WorkflowExecution:InstanceDataWrite:IntakeMasterSchemaPreview=false restores the previous behaviour.
